The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with zero stock. The full test suite passes offline (`mvn -q -o test`, no failures reported).

**What changed**

- `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findStockLevelsByWarehouse`: the query now adds `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use. I also updated its Javadoc, which said zero quantities were included.
- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`: added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNoStock`. It reproduces your example: WH-1 holds 10 bolts, 4 nuts are taken until none are left, and screws are set to 0. The list shows only "Bolt 10", and the nut quantity still answers 0.

Nothing was committed.
